newsitem.title: UK: NWE STRAIGHT-RUN FUEL OIL SOFTER WITH LOWER CRUDE.
newsitem.headline: NWE STRAIGHT-RUN FUEL OIL SOFTER WITH LOWER CRUDE.

text.p: European low sulphur straight-run prices eased a little at the start of the week in a very quiet market in which buyers were holding back to see where falling crude prices would settle.

One refiner said he was prepared to quote $113/$115 a tonne fob for his 0.5-0.7 percent material and a second refiner was at the $112/$113 mark, but both said no buyers came in. Others said one bid was heard at $106, down $2/$3 from Friday.
"I don't see bids in the market today. You see what happened to crude futures on Friday and buyers are now waiting for prices to settle," a trader said.
